source.name: GISCOE South Africa Cadastre / Erven layer

source.geometry: polygon; layer 1 metadata labels records Erven and native SG21KEY; maxRecordCount 1000
source.access: Anonymous read returned HTTP 200 with browser-like UA, Accept and en-ZA Accept-Language, session cookie jar and viewer Referer. Requests used small target bboxes and count 3; headers were used on successful calls.
